# Brain Builder

> Where a person sets up a company's Brain in the Platform - workspaces, ontology, processes, sources and mappings, views and access - reviews and publishes it, and connects and watches the company's sites and components.

| `L2-BRAIN-BUILDER/R-4` | The sources' two switches and the mapping panels «Zugriff» and «Zurückschreiben». | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/sources.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/source_edits.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/mappings.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/mapping_edits.py` |

| `L2-BRAIN-BUILDER/R-7` | Connector protocol 2.0 (draft, BUILDER_PROTOCOL_V2, off by default): the connector declarations Knovas Link reports, checked and kept on each component; writing back offered where the serving component declared actions for the source's kind and passed the conformance suite's write properties; the declared actions listed with the ways each can write (native_review only with review_outcome passed); with the switch on, the declaration decides whether a source of a kind can be written, never the Platform's catalogue of kinds (SPEC-write-back-13); the staging per source (direct unless set, plan C-Q1), sent with each approval; a source of a kind a connector at a site declared and the Builder has no form for, created and edited with the generic settings form (names and values, never a credential) and served to the site as entered, so a new source kind needs no Platform change (SPEC-write-back-13). | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/protocol_v2.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/protocol.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/sources.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/builder/source_edits.py` |

### Not responsible for

- Reading a company's sources at the company; components do (the sync component, behind Knovas Link).
- Storing or showing a source's original documents; they pass through Link from the source.
- Signing a site's certificate; a Knovas admin signs it, the Builder records it.
- Sign-in and the Platform's roles; the Platform's identity gate gives them.

### Terms

- workspace (one company's model: a draft and published versions)
- site (one machine at a company running Knovas Link)
- write proposal (a change of a fact an agent proposed, decided in «Freigaben»)
- change set (named actions of the tenant's ontology with the connector's preview, approved or rejected in «Freigaben»; write back v2)
- staging (how an approved write reaches a source - direct, or native_review in the source's own review step; kept per source)
- generic settings form (a source's settings as names and values, for a kind a connector declared that the Builder has no form of its own for)
- digest (the hash of everything a publish changes, which an approval holds)

## Hides

- The layout of the builder\_* tables and the workspace model's JSON.
- The German texts of the pages and of the codes (codes.py).
- How a component's state and alerts are computed from its heartbeat (components.py LIMITS).
- The shipped packs and their versions (builder/packs).

## Pattern

None stated.

## Decisions and risks

### Decisions

| Id | Statement |
|---|---|
| `DEC-0056` | A site's certificate: Knovas's client CA signs Link's request; the Builder records it and from then on requires its fingerprint (option A, A1). |
| `CL-4` | Accepting or rejecting a write proposal needs «publish»; «Freigaben» and «Verbindung» are read with a Platform role. |
| `C-Q1` | Write back v2 (FEAT-2026-11-10-write-back, decided A by the founder on 2026-11-10): the Builder keeps the staging per source (direct unless set, D-3) and sends it with each approval; the Brain refuses a mode the connector did not declare. |
| `C-8` | A source kind the Builder has no form for gets one generic settings form (names and values), not a protocol change (option B, the programme's coordinator, 2026-11-10; SPEC-write-back-13). The declaration describes no settings, so no field is typed from it (typed fields deferred to WB-20). A component behind Link whose declaration the schema allows is kept whatever its component kind (the coordinator, 2026-11-10, Q1). |

### Risks

| Id | Statement | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| `L2-BRAIN-BUILDER/RISK-01` | The Builder records who accepted a proposal or approved a change set, but the Brain does not yet bind the accept or the approval to a verified person (I2, WB-40). | The declared actor is recorded; verification comes with I2 (connection-layer.md, "What is built and what is not"). |

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
| `/status` | The Builder runs for its first tenant from a branch; its connection-layer pages are built and not deployed at a company. Live or planned is not read from the code. |
| `/source_paths` | Differs from the entry L2-BRAIN-BUILDER in the Brain's own component manifest (kept where the Brain is built): adds connector_protocol.py (the HTTP binding of builder/protocol.py), static/css/builder and the builder migrations; leaves out scripts/builder\_*.py (development tools). The manifest entry is to follow this card (boundaries.yaml says why). |
| `L2-BRAIN-BUILDER/component-settings/P-1` | No evidence; no test calls the settings route. |
| `L2-BRAIN-BUILDER/access-rule-remove/P-1` | No evidence; no test calls the rule-removal route. |
| `L2-BRAIN-BUILDER/site-package/L-1` | No evidence; read from builder_routes.py (\_PLATFORM_URL, the revoked check, the response headers). |
| `L2-BRAIN-BUILDER/protocol-heartbeat/L-1` | No evidence; MAX_BODY and the no_tenant answer in connector_protocol.py. Stated once for all eight protocol calls. |
| `/contract` | Every route's first need is its permission from ENDPOINT_PERMISSIONS; the test named shows that every endpoint is in the table and that the gate enforces it for representative roles, not each route's permission one by one. |
| `/uses` | Not declared because they have no card yet: the Platform's web app and its client (web_interface/app.py, knovas_client.py) that wire the Builder; the Knovas Connector's HTTP API (adapter and reader); the language-model API of the views assistant; GitHub (read through brain-runner). |
| `/operations` | The page scripts (static/js/builder) are not read by the code reader (Python only); what they call is in the routes listed here. |
